dedupe_keys.name: mopo industry technology catalogue nuts0 and nuts3 based on aidres

description: This is the industry technology catalogue of the Mopo energy system modelling project, built on the JRC AIDRES database and extended with data from PBL's MIDDEN industrial decarbonisation network, the Flemish GPBV installations list, Euro Chlor, JRC-IDEES and PyPSA-Eur. The Zenodo record lists three Excel workbooks at national (NUTS0) and NUTS3 level, one full and two variants with and without high value chemicals and ammonia, about 0.4 MB in total. It was published on 13 February 2026 (version v1) by Pieter Valkering and Hans Van de Put of VITO, free to download under CC BY 4.0. Coverage is Europe at NUTS0 and NUTS3 level. Caveats: column definitions and base years are not stated in the part of the record read, and values inherit the assumptions of the source databases. For simulation it gives regional industrial technologies and energy needs in a form ready for sector-coupled energy system models. Related catalogue records include AIDRES, the Mopo heat sector time series and IndustryHeat-EU.
